name: James Avery
known_for: Sterling Silver Charms Made in Texas

prices.note: Charms category with sz=1000: 779 tiles (776 Charms, 2 pendants, 1 glass enhancer bead excluded), no strike-through prices. Prices are each tile's default variant (740 sterling silver); 84 tiles say 'starting at'. Tiniest Elephant Charm $46 to Round St. Christopher Medal Charm (14K Yellow Gold) $450. Enamel Peppermint Charm $56, Texas Girl Charm $69.

notes: About: James Avery first started making jewelry in Kerrville, Texas in 1954; still designs and crafts its jewelry in Texas.
Shipping: free standard shipping and returns on all orders, 1-5 business days to all US states; international by phone only, buyer pays duties. Attach a Charm service adds 2-3 business days.
Returns: items must be received with a receipt on or before the 365th day since purchase; exchanges in any James Avery retail store, so us_stores true.
